title: Clo User Story – Calida
description:
Learn how CALIDA, a Swiss company specializing in underwear, nightwear, and loungewear, utilizes CLO 3D software.

"Before we implemented CLO, I always had to wait for the sewing sample to see if my pattern was good and that I put the right lines. And now, I can do the pattern, bring that into CLO, and have a look on the avatar if everything is right and good, and in the right place. So, I can save samples and time and yeah, that's great."

---

transcript: Calida for me is high quality, super comfy and well-fitting underwear, nightwear and loungewear. So I'm Fabienne Meurie and I'm leading the technical product development team at Calida. These are the pattern makers and the 3D developer. So it was in the beginning of 2021. We set up workarounds and workflows into our company using 3D in different departments. So we do hollows, we do packaging, the visual merchandising guidelines and so on. Before we implemented CLO, I always had to wait for the sewn samples to see if my pattern is good and that I put the right lines and all that. And now I can do the pattern, bring that into CLO and have a look on the avatar if everything is right and good and in the right place. So I can save samples and time and yeah, that's great. The integration of CLO3D resulted in closer or even new collaborations between different departments like the technical product development with the design team or with the visual merchandising, which we didn't have before. So another benefit with Chlo is that for me, for developing the kids collection, I can easily place the motif prints and check the size or the rise placement at the right position so it's really more obvious for everyone, also in the design process and also for the sales team. The benefits we have seen implementing Chlo in relation to visual merchandising that we were faster than before because combinations or changes could be done really fast in 3D so we also could save money or the effort to order something that we might not use for the window. We are going on building up libraries. And bring them to perfection and we will also go on that we have our whole collection in 3D. So I really believe in that 3D is and will be the future of garment manufacturing. We are really happy and we thank Chlo for that great support.
markdown_content: ## Introduction to Calida and CLO3D Integration This section introduces Calida, a brand known for high-quality, comfortable underwear, nightwear, and loungewear, and explains the integration of CLO3D software into their product development processes. It highlights key roles, initial implementation, and the purpose behind adopting 3D technology. Calida specializes in producing high-quality, comfortable, and well-fitting underwear, nightwear, and loungewear. Fabienne Meurie leads the technical product development team at Calida, which includes pattern makers and 3D developers. In early 2021, Calida began integrating 3D workflows into various departments, such as pattern making, packaging, and visual merchandising. Before implementing CLO3D, the team had to wait for physical sewn samples to verify the accuracy of patterns and design details. With CLO3D, patterns can be imported directly, allowing immediate visualization on a digital avatar to check fit, lines, and placement. This digital approach reduces the need for physical samples, saving both time and resources. ## Impact of CLO3D on Cross-Department Collaboration This section details how CLO3D has fostered new collaborations between departments at Calida and improved internal communication and design processes. The introduction of CLO3D resulted in closer and even new collaborations between departments that previously had limited interaction. For example, the technical product development team now works more closely with the design and visual merchandising teams. This collaboration enhances the development process and aligns the teams on fit, aesthetics, and presentation. ## Enhancements in Kids Collection Development This section explains how CLO3D improves the design and verification process for Calida’s kids collection, with a focus on print placement and size accuracy. One specific benefit of CLO3D is for the development of Calida’s kids collection. Using the software, designers can easily place motif prints on garments and verify their exact size and rise placement on a 3D avatar. This capability makes print positioning clearer for all stakeholders, including designers and the sales team, facilitating better communication and decision-making during the design process. ## Efficiency Gains in Visual Merchandising with CLO3D This section covers the advantages CLO3D brings to Calida’s visual merchandising, including faster iterations and cost savings. In visual merchandising, CLO3D has accelerated the process of creating and modifying outfit combinations. Changes can be made quickly in 3D, allowing the team to experiment with window displays without the expense and effort of ordering physical samples that may not be used. This efficiency leads to cost savings and more agile presentations. ## Future Plans and Commitment to 3D Technology This section outlines Calida’s ongoing efforts to build comprehensive 3D libraries and their commitment to expanding 3D usage across their collections. Calida is actively building and refining 3D libraries of their garment components, aiming to achieve perfection in digital assets. The company plans to digitize its entire collection in 3D, fully embracing this technology as the future of garment manufacturing. They express strong confidence that 3D solutions like CLO3D will continue to transform their workflows and product development. --- Calida credits CLO3D with significantly improving their development speed, collaboration, and cost efficiency, and they appreciate the support received during the implementation process.
